text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French President Chirac reiterates France's desire to implement the 'oil-for-food' deal signed by Iraq and the United Nations.
- The international company Arbbela is to organise a food and medical fair in Baghdad.
- Yemen and Russia stress their keenness to maintain Iraq's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- The health minister holds talks with the head of a South Korean firm on bringing medicine to Iraq.
